title: Campaign tess-mono-01: TESS single-transit search (draft)
summary: Declarative plan for a search of TESS light curves for isolated (single) transits. Draft: no targets selected, thresholds unset, and most steps depend on modules not yet implemented.

items.title: TESS single-transit search
items.description: Search TESS SPOC light curves and cutouts for isolated transits, then audit each against detrending, blending, pointing and prior-art alternatives.
